title: Ephraim the scribe

paragraphs: A student of Reish Lakish who reported in his name at the end of Bava Metzia. In the Jerusalem Talmud there, Ephraim said in the name of R' Shimon ben Lakish [רשב״ל]: “They should divide.”[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Bava Metzia 119a paragraph explicitly calls Ephraim Safra a student of Reish Lakish and has him reporting in Reish Lakish’s name. The whole Guggenheimer final halakhah, Bava Metzia 10:6, has Ephraim in Reish Lakish’s name saying ‘They should divide.’ Neither selected passage fully spells Shimon ben Lakish; the supplied רשב״ל is therefore rendered R' Shimon ben Lakish with the acronym visible. Hyman’s end-of-tractate locator remains; no additional identity or teacher-graph admission follows.
